design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — employer_quarterly_contributions task 1 (root: taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request; prerequisite: taxacct_ext_late_report_penalty).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}. One prerequisite problem; both computations carry 6 factors (penalty: 5 parameter + 1 method; relief: 5 parameter + 1 method). Occupied by task 0: taxacct_ext_estimated_assessment / book_estimated_assessment_54fbfb5a and taxacct_ext_credit_refund_request / request_credit_refund_f44db5b5. Claimed here (disjoint): taxacct_ext_late_report_penalty / assess_late_report_penalty_9b2fdf0c (agent, taxacct_penalty_assessed) and taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request / request_penalty_relief_44d7156f (user, constraining taxacct_credit_adjusted with reason penalty_abated). After this task every extended policy is covered and no tool is idle. Task 0's seed history already uses this task's penalty rule (its 2025-Q1 penalty 519.00) and this task's seed uses task 0's estimate rule (the 2026-Q2 estimate 1,500.91), so the charter is applied consistently across worlds.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: "we paid a late-filing penalty on our third-quarter report; refund it, it was a one-off". Scored figure: requested_amount of the relief request. Hidden chain: the relief rule's prerequisite sentence — "The relief share is not fixed until the ledger carries a late report penalty for the quarter of the original report with the latest filing date, whenever that report was filed after its due date." — sends the agent to the reports, where the latest-filed original report, 2026-Q2 (due 2026-07-31), was filed 2026-11-23 with no penalty on the ledger; the agent must first work out and book that penalty (6-factor computation), which then counts against the relief history share. Depth: relief -> penalty. Breadth: reports (lateness, wages, counts, channel, portal filings), penalty and estimate history across two windows, the account's registration date, the paid penalty and the relieved quarter's contributions, and the charge product's notice-of-claim answers (cross-difficulty). Negative space: the 2026-Q2 penalty is booked but not relieved (the caller asked only about the paid 2026-Q3 penalty; nothing in the persona asks for relief on 2026-Q2).

[Problem-tree card] root taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request <- taxacct_ext_late_report_penalty; kind value_input, gate other_late_penalties, form state. Four-point test of the prerequisite sentence: (1) negated direction "is not fixed until" joining this policy's result (the relief share) to a waited-on state; the affirmative rewrite "the relief share is fixed only after the ledger carries ..." adds or drops nothing; a relief desk states a decision as not made until the account is complete, while task 0's refund sentence uses the affirmative "only after", so the charter carries both directions; (2) the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a late report penalty entry on the ledger for the quarter of the latest-filed report, when that report was late), no action named; (3) no tool, policy id or code token; (4) hard requirement over "the quarter of the original report with the latest filing date, whenever that report was filed after its due date" — exactly the condition field, and exactly the report the penalty rule works from, so the sentence never asks for a penalty the penalty rule cannot compute. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings about a late report penalty entry: the penalty policy's tool (the estimate tool writes contribution assessments; the two request tools write requests). Derivation: sentence + reports (2026-Q2 filed 115 days late) + ledger (penalties only for 2024-Q2 and 2026-Q3) + the penalty rule ("A late report penalty is owed for every quarterly contribution and wage report filed after its due date, ... worked out from the original report with the latest filing date") -> book the 2026-Q2 penalty. False at the opening: report row 2026-Q2 filed_date 2026-11-23 > due_date 2026-07-31; no taxacct_penalty_assessed row with quarter 2026-Q2. Order: penalty (step 7) then relief (step 9). Deletion run: skipping the penalty gives requested_amount 77.68 instead of 51.79 (history share 0.75 instead of 0.5) and leaves the 645.76 row and balance change out of the terminal state. The customer's own write is the relief request (asking for an abatement is the employer's act); the persona names neither problem nor the missing penalty; tools validate nothing.

[Factor card — penalty (expected 645.76; whole baseline 78.46)]
- lateness_wage_share (parameter): >90 days -> 0.003 / 31–90 -> 0.002 / otherwise class 0.001. World: 115 days -> 0.003 x 78,460.00 = 235.38 (above the 50.00 flat). Baseline 331.92.
- repeat_lookback_length (method, window convention): liability >= 120 months -> 12-month lookback / < 36 months -> whole liability (months + 1) / otherwise 24 months. World: registered 2024-02-12, 33 whole months -> 34-month lookback. Baseline (24 months) 528.07. Near-miss: the 2024-08-20 penalty sits 27 months back — outside the standard 24-month lookback, inside this young account's whole-liability lookback.
- repeat_multiplier (parameter — it picks the multiplier in an unchanged formula, applied before the cap): 2+ penalties -> x2.0 / one -> x1.5 / none -> x1. World: 2024-08-20 and 2026-11-13 -> x2.0 = 470.76. Baseline 410.38.
- employer_size_cap (parameter): peak >= 50 -> 1,000 / >= 10 -> 500 / else class max 250. World: counts 9/11/11 -> 500, not reached (470.76). Baseline (250 binds) 425.0.
- paper_filing_charge (parameter; channel and size are fields of the same report row, so not counted as multi-source): paper and >= 50 -> 200 / paper and 10–49 -> 100 / otherwise 0. World: paper, 11 -> 100. Baseline 545.76.
- estimate_charge (parameter, multi-source: an estimated assessment ledger entry and the report's filing date): filed > 60 days after an estimate for its quarter -> 150 / after an estimate, <= 60 days -> 75 / no estimate -> 0. World: estimate 2026-10-01, report 2026-11-23 = 53 days -> 75. Baseline 570.76.
Computation: min(500, 235.38 x 2.0) + 100.00 + 75.00 = 645.76.

[Factor card — relief (expected 51.79; whole baseline 212.38 = full penalty, the base rule's full abatement)]
- late_penalty_history_share (parameter): other late report penalties within the relief lookback, excluding the relieved quarter: 2+ -> 0.5 / one -> 0.75 / none -> 1. World after the penalty write, 34-month whole-liability lookback: 2026-Q2 (booked at step 7) and 2024-08-20 -> 0.5. Baseline 103.58.
- relief_lookback_length (method — each non-fall-through tier takes the counting window from a different record date rather than a constant): delinquent account -> counted from registration, the whole liability (one month more than its whole months of liability) / active with no late-payment interest within 12 months -> counted back only to the entry date of its most recent late-payment interest entry (one month more than the whole months since it), or from registration when it has none / otherwise 8 abatement lookback quarters x 3 = 24 (baseline). World: account status delinquent; registered 2024-02-12 -> 33 whole months -> 34-month window. Near-miss: the 2024-08-20 penalty is 27 months back, inside the whole liability, outside the standard 24. Baseline 77.68.
- estimated_assessment_share (parameter): estimates within 12 months: 2+ -> 0.7 / one -> 0.85 / none -> 1. World: one (2026-10-01). Baseline 60.93.
- quarter_payment_share (parameter): relieved quarter's contributions not fully covered by payments and credits -> 0.8 / covered with the last payment after the due date -> 0.9 / covered by the due date -> 1. World: 2026-Q3 1,495.80 paid 2026-11-09 > 2026-10-31, no credits -> 0.9. Baseline 57.54.
- claim_notice_cooperation_share (parameter, cross-difficulty: charge): most recent notice-of-claim answer recorded late without good cause (XLATEST by response date over late answers): within 365 days -> 0.85 / 366–730 days -> 0.95 / none -> 1. World: answered 2026-05-06 (due 2026-05-01, late), 211 days back -> 0.85. Baseline 60.93. The other position (answered on time 2025-11-24) is the near-miss.
- paper_filing_relief_factor (parameter — it picks a multiplier; multi-source: the relieved report's channel AND the portal filings of other report rows): paper with >= 2 portal reports in 12 months -> x0.75 / paper with exactly one -> x0.9 / otherwise x1. World: 2026-Q3 on paper; portal reports 2026-01-26 and 2026-04-27 (2025-10-27 is 13 whole months back, the near-miss) -> x0.75. Baseline 69.05.
Computation: 212.38 x 0.5 x 0.85 x 0.9 x 0.85 x 0.75 = 51.79.
Task floors: method factors = repeat_lookback_length (penalty) and relief_lookback_length (relief); multi-source = estimate_charge and paper_filing_relief_factor (conditions over distinct records); cross-difficulty = claim_notice_cooperation_share (XLATEST value read of the charge product, seeded for this employer).

[Base-invariant card] Penalty write (subject taxacct_penalty_assessed): taxacct_evt_penalty_interest, gate penalty_once_per_quarter (dedup on employer account + quarter + late_report): no 2026-Q2 penalty exists (existing ones are 2024-Q2 and 2026-Q3) -> satisfied; the base amount sentence is replaced and declared in overwrite. Relief request (subject taxacct_credit_adjusted, the abatement credit the request asks for): taxacct_evt_penalty_interest, gate abatement_request_window (time): anchor = penalty assessment date (employer_tax_ledger.entry_date of 5d4a5120-fd64-45f3-a17f-63074aa7dd80 = 2026-11-13), 30 calendar days from the day after, inclusive, relation not_after; 2026-12-03 is day 20 -> in time; 2026-12-13 in time, 2026-12-14 late. The base "abated in full, never in part, when prior late reports is zero" clause is replaced by the relief schedule and declared in overwrite (the window clause is kept). No other base policy has these subjects.

[Business-object card] Account 859dbefa-a583-46df-a3e6-3bec818343b8. Penalty object: quarter 2026-Q2, report filed 2026-11-23 (the original report with the latest filing date). Relief object: the 2026-Q3 penalty entry 5d4a5120-fd64-45f3-a17f-63074aa7dd80 (212.38, paid 2026-11-20 by ACH-26112071146 — the most recent penalty payment). Excluded: the 2024-Q2 penalty (paid 2024-08-28, older, outside the 24-month relief lookback), the 2026-Q2 penalty just booked (unpaid; not asked about), estimate/replacement rows (contributions, not penalties).

[World rows and why] 11 original reports 2024-Q1..2026-Q3 for a seasonal landscaper (taxable wages follow the 14,000 base; spring/summer peaks); 2024-Q2 filed 14 days late (penalty 69.80, the near-miss for the lookback), 2026-Q2 filed on paper 115 days late after the 2026-10-01 estimate, 2026-Q3 filed on paper 9 days late (penalty 212.38 computed with this rule on 2026-11-13: 0.001 x 74,920.00 = 74.92, x1.5 for the 2024 penalty inside the 34-month whole liability, +100 paper). Ledger (40 rows): assessments at the 0.0270 new employer rate, same-day payments and reserve credits, the 2026-Q2 estimate (computed with task 0's estimate rule on 2026-10-01) and its replacement 558.65 on filing, the 800.00 partial payment, October and November interest on the unpaid 2026-Q2 balance, both penalties and their payments. Account: new employer standard class (rate 0.0270, not yet experience rated), delinquent because 2026-Q2 contributions (1,259.56) remain unpaid; balance_due 1,287.17 and reserve_balance equal the ledger sums. Charge positions (charge product, read-only): one answered late in May 2026 (closed with nothing charged), one answered on time and relieved. Automatic clauses checked: interest on 2026-Q2 continues monthly through the interest run (not an agent write); the delinquency cannot be cured (contributions unpaid); no other report is late without a penalty after the 2026-Q2 penalty is booked; the 2027 rate notice is not yet due for this young account.

[Persona design] Rosalind Thornquist, owner, rueful and plain-spoken, off-season. Volunteers only: the third-quarter report went in late, a penalty was charged and paid, she wants it refunded as a one-off and to request it now. Identity on request (phone 6085554731, FEIN last four 4815, ZIP 53772; email spare). Other quarters only if asked (the spring/summer report also late, paper, late November, 800.00 paid); prior lateness: does not remember; notices of claim: one answered a few days late this spring. Passive: accepts booking first; asks once what cuts the amount; submits the request herself; ends on "received". Never states a figure or a missing penalty.

[Reachability walk-through] find_customers by phone -> verify (3 details) -> account (registration date) -> reports (2026-Q2 filed late, no penalty; channels; counts) -> ledger (penalties, estimate, payments, entry 5d4a5120-fd64-45f3-a17f-63074aa7dd80) -> charge positions (late answer 2026-05-06) -> unlock + book penalty 645.76 for 2026-Q2 -> unlock user tool; the caller lodges the relief request for 51.79 on 2026-Q3 citing 5d4a5120-fd64-45f3-a17f-63074aa7dd80; the receipt returns in the shared transcript. One frozen_time; the tax review decision and refund are outside the tree.

[Easiest mistakes] relieving the full 212.38 (first-time view) or 77.68 (forgetting the missing 2026-Q2 penalty); counting other penalties over the standard 24 months on a delinquent account (77.68 as well); using the standard 24-month repeat lookback (penalty 528.07); applying the cap before the multiplier or the charges before the cap; capping at 250; counting the 2025-10-27 portal filing; treating the late notice answer as older than a year.

[Verification code and outputs] The /tmp generator (outside the write domain, removed afterwards) replays gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each policy with check_compute's evaluator: penalty 645.76 (factor baselines {'lateness_wage_share': 331.92, 'repeat_lookback_length': 528.07, 'repeat_multiplier': 410.38, 'employer_size_cap': 425.0, 'paper_filing_charge': 545.76, 'estimate_charge': 570.76}; all-baseline 78.46); balance after it 1932.93; relief 51.79 (factor baselines {'late_penalty_history_share': 103.58, 'relief_lookback_length': 77.68, 'estimated_assessment_share': 60.93, 'quarter_payment_share': 57.54, 'claim_notice_cooperation_share': 60.93, 'paper_filing_relief_factor': 69.05}; all-baseline 212.38); relief with the penalty skipped 77.68. Per-task gates run with --task 1 (outputs in the final report).

[Closure] taxacct_ext_late_report_penalty -> assess_late_report_penalty_9b2fdf0c -> computations[0] (step 7, penalty_amount) -> new 2026-Q2 penalty row + balance_due 1932.93; taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request -> request_penalty_relief_44d7156f -> computations[1] (step 9, requested_amount) -> new employer_account_requests row (penalty_abatement, 2026-Q3, received). required_documents = charter_scope.extended_policies. Difficulty union after this task: four extended policies, four tools, pairwise disjoint across tasks 0 and 1. No handoff in gold.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the two rules, the tool docstrings, the six lookups and the persona: the relief sentence forces a check of the latest-filed report; 2026-Q2 has none -> penalty: 115 days -> 0.003; young account -> whole-liability lookback -> two penalties -> x2; peak 11 -> cap 500; paper +100; estimate 53 days earlier +75 -> 645.76; relief on the most recently paid penalty (2026-Q3, 212.38): delinquent account -> counted over its whole liability since registration (34 months) -> two other penalties -> 0.5, one estimate -> 0.85, paid late -> 0.9, late notice answer 211 days ago -> 0.85, paper with two portal filings -> 0.75 -> 51.79. Matches gold.


[Round 2 rework — audit audits/policy_task/employer_quarterly_contributions (_difficulty.md, 1.md)] T1-F1 / F-1: paper_filing_relief_factor relabelled parameter. T1-F2 / F-1: repeat_multiplier relabelled parameter; the penalty now counts 5 parameter + 1 method (repeat_lookback_length). To keep an honest method in the relief, a new relief_lookback_length factor decides the window the other penalties are counted over (delinquent 36 / clean 12 / standard 24 months). T1-F3 / F-3: request_timing_share removed (its 'days from assessment' tiers had no realistic basis). F-2: the cooperation share now reads the most recent answer recorded as late without good cause (XLATEST over late answers), so only one answer drives the tier and late-with-good-cause answers do not count. O-4: the penalty's final sentence states the single rounding on the sum. O-5: the penalty's inputs no longer pin a 34-month window. O-6: the payment share counts payments and credits. O-8: the prerequisite sentence names only the latest-filed report's quarter, the one the penalty rule can compute. O-9: the relief is decided by the Department's tax review unit. False dossier claim fixed: paper_filing_charge is single-record, not multi-source. Recomputed: relief 51.79 (was 73.80), skip-prerequisite 77.68 (was 98.40), factor baselines {'late_penalty_history_share': 103.58, 'relief_lookback_length': 77.68, 'estimated_assessment_share': 60.93, 'quarter_payment_share': 57.54, 'claim_notice_cooperation_share': 60.93, 'paper_filing_relief_factor': 69.05}; penalty unchanged at 645.76.

[Round 3 rework — audit revision_2 (_difficulty.md R2-F1, 1.md T1-R2-F1)] relief_lookback_length no longer picks one of three constants: a delinquent account's other penalties are counted over its whole liability since registration (MONTHS(registered_date, NOW) + 1), an active account with no late-payment interest in the payment record months counts back only to its most recent late-payment interest entry (MONTHS(that entry, NOW) + 1, or the whole liability when it has none), and only the fall-through keeps the standard 8 quarters x 3; the constants delinquent_lookback_months and clean_record_lookback_months are gone. On this world the delinquent tier gives 34 months (registered 2024-02-12), which still admits the 2024-08-20 penalty: relief 51.79, factor baselines unchanged (relief_lookback_length 77.68), skip-prerequisite 77.68. Counts: penalty 5 parameter + 1 method (repeat_lookback_length); relief 5 parameter + 1 method (relief_lookback_length).
user_scenario: You are Rosalind Thornquist, owner of Thornquist Ridge Landscaping LLC, a seasonal landscaping and grounds-care outfit in Pellam Lake. It is early December, the crews are laid off for the winter, and you are catching up on the office work you could not get to during the season; you are friendly, a little rueful, and you talk like a business owner rather than a bookkeeper. You open by saying that your third-quarter wage report went in late last month because the busy season ran long, that the Department charged a late-filing penalty for it, and that you already paid that penalty; you would like to ask for that penalty to be refunded, since it was a one-off slip, and you want to put the request in on this call. You run the account yourself and can act for the business. When the agent asks which account, you give the business name and the phone number 6085554731; to verify, you give the last four digits of the business's federal employer identification number, 4815, and the mailing ZIP code, 53772; if one more detail is needed you give the email address office@thornquistridgelandscaping.com. You do not have the state account number or any entry numbers handy and expect the agent to look them up. You only talk about other quarters if the agent asks: then you say the spring-and-summer quarter's report also went in late, mailed on paper in late November, that you paid eight hundred dollars toward it at the time, and that the rest of that quarter is still being sorted out with your accountant. If the agent asks whether you have ever been late before, you say you honestly do not remember and that the agent can see the history better than you can. If the agent asks about notices about former workers' unemployment claims, you say one came in this spring while you were away and your office answered it a few days late. If the agent tells you something else has to be put on the account before your request can be worked out, you sigh, say that if that is how the rules work they should go ahead, and do not argue. If the agent explains that only part of the penalty can be asked for, you ask once, in plain words, what is cutting it down, accept the answer without disputing any figure, and say you still want to request whatever is allowed. You never suggest an amount and never correct the agent's numbers. When the agent hands you the relief request to submit, you submit it yourself with exactly the details the agent gives you, and once you see the request has been received you thank the agent and end the call.

base_preconditions.condition: A penalty abatement is granted only when it is requested no later than the abatement window after the penalty assessment date.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A penalty abatement is granted only when it is requested no later than the abatement window after the penalty assessment date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the penalty assessment date, and a request on the last day is in time.

boundary_check.just_before: The penalty was assessed 2026-11-13; the 30-day window counts from 2026-11-14 and ends 2026-12-13. A request on 2026-12-03 is day 20, inside the window.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A request on 2026-12-13 (day 30, inclusive) would still be in time; one on 2026-12-14 would be too late and no relief could be granted.

edges.condition: When the original report with the latest filing date on the account was filed after its due date, the employer tax ledger carries a late report penalty entry for that report's quarter.
edges.policy_source: The relief share is not fixed until the ledger carries a late report penalty for the quarter of the original report with the latest filing date, whenever that report was filed after its due date.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The original report with the latest filing date is the 2026-Q2 report, filed 2026-11-23 after its due date 2026-07-31, but the ledger has no late report penalty for 2026-Q2: its 2026-Q2 entries are the 2026-10-01 estimated assessment, the 2026-11-23 replacement assessment, the 800.00 payment with its reserve credit and two interest entries. Penalties exist only for 2024-Q2 and 2026-Q3.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The penalty written at step 7 adds a taxacct_penalty_assessed entry for 2026-Q2 (late_report, 645.76, entry date 2026-12-03); the latest-filed report's quarter now carries its penalty, and other_late_penalties within the delinquent account's whole-liability relief lookback (34 months) rises from 1 to 2, moving the history share from 0.75 to 0.5.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: relief depends on the penalty. The penalty reads reports and the penalty history, which the relief request (an employer_account_requests row) never touches, so the penalty figure is the same whenever it is booked; the relief reads the penalty count, which the penalty write changes. The prerequisite sentence pins the order: the relief share is not fixed until the quarter of the latest-filed late report carries its penalty.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the 2026-Q2 penalty leaves other_late_penalties at 1 (history share 0.75), so requested_amount would be 77.68 instead of 51.79; the terminal ledger would also lack the 645.76 2026-Q2 penalty row and balance_due would stay at 1287.17 instead of 1932.93.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for the paid 2026-Q3 penalty to be refunded. It never mentions a missing penalty, the 2026-Q2 quarter's penalty or anything to be booked first; the late spring-and-summer report surfaces only if the agent asks about other quarters, and the persona does not know whether she was late before.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: request_penalty_relief_44d7156f records the request with whatever amount it is given and never reads penalties, reports or estimates; assess_late_report_penalty_9b2fdf0c books the penalty given without checking lateness or duplicates. Neither returns an error when the prerequisite is unmet (task_tools.py: one ctx.create, plus one ctx.update of balance_due for the penalty).
